cnTitle: 紫微斗数化禄转忌怎么看：禄入某宫再飞出忌的连锁解读与判断顺序
enTitle: How to Read Prosperity-to-Jealousy Chains in Zi Wei Dou Shu
enDesc: A Prosperity-to-Jealousy chain is one of the most misunderstood structures in Flying-Star Zi Wei Dou Shu. People often rejoice when Prosperity enters the Wealth Palace, then panic when that palace stem flies Jealousy into the Spouse Palace, assuming money will be lost through relationships. In reality, the chain describes energy flow: Prosperity marks where resources enter, Jealousy marks where they become pressure or a lesson. Read together, they form a complete causal chain.
cnDesc: 化禄转忌是飞星体系里最容易被误读的结构之一。很多人看到化禄入财帛就开心，再看到财帛宫干飞出化忌入夫妻就慌了，以为「赚了钱就因感情破财」。实际上化禄转忌讲的是能量的流向：禄标记资源从哪里进来，忌标记这些资源最终在哪个领域形成压力或课题。两者连起来看，才是完整的因果链。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数权忌交战怎么化解：化权化忌同宫的拉扯内耗与破局方法
enTitle: Resolving Authority-Jealousy Conflict in Zi Wei Dou Shu
enDesc: Authority-Jealousy conflict is one of the most uncomfortable structures in a chart. Authority represents control, drive, and the need to take charge; Jealousy represents obstruction, entanglement, and inability to let go. When these energies collide in the same or opposite palace, it is like pressing the accelerator and brake simultaneously—the car shakes, the driver is exhausted, and progress is uncertain. Understanding this structure is not about eliminating it, but learning to find a rhythm within the tension.
cnDesc: 权忌交战是命盘里最让人难受的结构之一。化权代表掌控、推进、要做主，化忌代表阻滞、纠结、放不下。两颗星的能量在同一个宫位或对宫撞在一起，就像开车时一边踩油门一边踩刹车——车在抖，人在累，事情却不一定往前走。理解权忌交战，不是为了消除它，而是学会在拉扯中找到发力的节奏。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数科禄相逢：化科化禄同宫的名声与实利双收格局
enTitle: Recognition Meets Prosperity: Fame and Substance in Zi Wei Dou Shu
enDesc: Recognition governs fame, benefactors, documents, and approval; Prosperity governs resources, enjoyment, and tangible benefit. When these two energies meet, it is traditionally called "Recognition meets Prosperity"—both visibility and real gain appear. But this configuration does not guarantee effortless fame and fortune; the key is whether they form a closed loop in the same domain: can fame convert into resources, and can resources sustain fame?
cnDesc: 化科主名声、贵人、文书、认可，化禄主资源、享受、实际利益。两颗星的能量碰到一起，就是传统说的「科禄相逢」——既有被看见的机会，又有实实在在的收获。但科禄相逢不是躺着就能名利双收，关键在于两者是否在同一个领域闭环：名声能不能转化为资源，资源能不能支撑名声。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数自化禄详解：本宫主动向外输出的能量模式与边界管理
enTitle: Self-Prosperity in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Active Outward Energy and Boundary Management
enDesc: Self-Prosperity is a type of palace-stem flying transformation where a palace own stem flies Prosperity back to itself or to another palace. Unlike natal Prosperity, Self-Prosperity is not "given to you by others" but "what you actively give out." It represents outward-diffusing, sharing, willing-to-invest energy, but without boundaries it easily becomes "giving-type exhaustion."
cnDesc: 自化禄是宫干飞化的一种，指某个宫位自己的宫干飞出化禄回到本宫或飞向其他宫。和生年化禄不同，自化禄不是「别人给你的」，而是「你自己主动给出去的」。它代表一种向外扩散、乐于分享、愿意投入的能量，但如果没有边界，容易变成「付出型消耗」。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数自化权：主动掌控型能量的识别与领导力转化
enTitle: Self-Authority in Zi Wei Dou Shu: From Control Desire to Leadership
enDesc: Self-Authority occurs when a palace stem flies Authority, meaning that palace actively seeks dominance and wants to control the situation. Unlike natal Authority, which is "power given to you by others" or "authority built into the chart," Self-Authority is "you actively taking power." It gives strong drive and opinions, but used in the wrong place it becomes domineering, stubborn, and power-struggling.
cnDesc: 自化权是宫干飞出化权，代表这个宫位主动争取主导权、想要掌控局面。和生年化权不同，生年化权是「别人赋予你权力」或「格局里自带权威」，自化权是「你自己主动去拿权」。它给人很强的行动力和主见，但如果用错地方，就变成强势、固执、和人争权。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数自化忌：自我纠结型能量的识别与内耗转化
enTitle: Self-Jealousy in Zi Wei Dou Shu: From Self-Obsession to Deep Reflection
enDesc: Self-Jealousy occurs when a palace stem flies Jealousy, meaning that palace actively turns inward, ruminates, and cannot let go. Unlike natal Jealousy, which is "a lesson given by external circumstances," Self-Jealousy is "you being hard on yourself." It makes thinking deep and perfection-seeking, but also easily leads to internal friction, regret, and self-doubt.
cnDesc: 自化忌是宫干飞出化忌，代表这个宫位主动向内纠结、反复琢磨、放不下。和生年化忌不同，生年化忌是「外界给你的课题」，自化忌是「你自己跟自己过不去」。它让人思维深刻、追求完美，但也容易陷入内耗、后悔、自我怀疑。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数日月同宫：太阳太阴同守丑未的阴阳并济格局与人生方向
enTitle: Sun-Moon Conjunction in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Yin-Yang Balance in Chou/Wei Palaces
enDesc: Sun-Moon conjunction is a special configuration where the Sun and Moon stars occupy the same Chou or Wei palace. The Sun is yang, governing outwardness, brightness, and action; the Moon is yin, governing introspection, gentleness, and thought. Two opposite natures together create a "yin-yang balance" structure—both drive and sensitivity, both sociability and solitude. But this configuration also has inner contradiction: when to be outward and when to be inward requires discernment.
cnDesc: 日月同宫是紫微斗数中一个特殊的格局，指太阳星和太阴星同守在丑宫或未宫。太阳属阳，主外放、光明、行动力；太阴属阴，主内敛、温柔、思考力。两颗性质相反的星在一起，形成「阴阳并济」的结构——既有冲劲又有细腻，既能社交又能独处。但这个格局也有内在矛盾：什么时候该外放、什么时候该内敛，需要自己拿捏。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数贪狼坐命：欲望驱动型人格的天赋、风险与人生管理
enTitle: Tan Lang in the Life Palace: Desire-Driven Personality, Talent, and Life Management
enDesc: Tan Lang (Greedy Wolf) is one of the most complex stars in Zi Wei Dou Shu, governing desire, enjoyment, sociability, and versatility. People with Tan Lang in the Life Palace naturally have strong curiosity and possessiveness toward the world—wanting to experience, to possess, to become. This desire is their greatest source of motivation and their greatest risk. Well managed, Tan Lang people are the most energetic and creative; poorly managed, they easily become addicted, scattered, and achieve nothing.
cnDesc: 贪狼是紫微斗数中最复杂的星曜之一，主欲望、享受、社交、多才多艺。贪狼坐命的人，天生对世界有强烈的好奇心和占有欲——想体验、想拥有、想成为。这种欲望是他们最大的动力来源，也是最大的风险所在。管理得好，贪狼是最有活力和创造力的人；管理不好，就容易沉迷、分散、一事无成。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数破军坐命：破旧立新型人格的变革天赋与人生节奏
enTitle: Po Jun in the Life Palace: Transformative Personality and Life Rhythm
enDesc: Po Jun (Broken Army) is the most transformative star in Zi Wei Dou Shu, governing destruction, innovation, change, and "break first, build later." People with Po Jun in the Life Palace are naturally impatient with the status quo—old patterns, old environments, old relationships—once they feel something is wrong, they want to tear it down and start over. This transformative spirit makes them pioneers, but also makes their lives more turbulent than average.
cnDesc: 破军是紫微斗数中最具变革性的星曜，主破坏、创新、变动、先破后立。破军坐命的人，天生对「现状」不耐烦——旧的模式、旧的环境、旧的关系，一旦觉得不对，就想推倒重来。这种变革精神让他们成为开创新局的人，但也让他们的人生比一般人更多起伏和动荡。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数机梁会合：天机天梁智囊型格局的潜能发掘与职业方向
enTitle: Ji Liang Configuration in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Strategic Advisor Talent and Career Direction
enDesc: Ji Liang configuration refers to Ji Ji (Witty Messenger) and Tian Liang (Blessing Beam) meeting in trine or same palace. Ji Ji governs strategy, change, and agile thinking; Tian Liang governs principles, systems, experience, and elder benefactors. Together they form a "strategic yet principled" advisor structure—can generate ideas and uphold底线. Traditionally "Ji Liang excels at military strategy," suitable for staff officer, consultant, planner, and research roles.
cnDesc: 机梁会合指天机星和天梁星在三方四正会照或同宫。天机主谋略、变动、思维敏捷；天梁主原则、制度、经验、长辈贵人。两颗星配合，就是「有谋略又有原则」的智囊型结构——既能出主意，又能守底线。传统说「机梁善谈兵」，适合做参谋、顾问、策划、研究类工作。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数地空地劫详解：空耗与灵感并存的非常规能量与使用方法
enTitle: Di Kong and Di Jie in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Void-Drain and Inspiration
enDesc: Di Kong and Di Jie are the most misunderstood malefics in Zi Wei Dou Shu. Many people see them and immediately conclude "wealth loss" or "effort in vain," but their essence is "unconventionality"—they break常规 paths and make people play outside the rules. Used well, they bring inspiration and breakthrough; used poorly, they bring dissipation and futility.
cnDesc: 地空地劫是紫微斗数中最容易被误解的煞曜。很多人一看到空劫就断「破财」「空忙一场」，实际上空劫的本质是「非常规」——它打破常规路径，让人不按常理出牌。用好了是灵感和突破，用不好才是耗散和落空。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天刑天姚：杂曜中的规则与魅力如何影响命盘判断
enTitle: Tian Xing and Tian Yao in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Minor Stars of Rules and Charm
enDesc: Tian Xing and Tian Yao are second-tier minor stars, less powerful than major stars and transformations, but with clear指向 in specific domains. Tian Xing governs law, rules, litigation, surgery, and solitary harshness; Tian Yao governs charm, romance, talent, and allure. They are not independent bases for fortune judgment, but act as "plus-minus factors" on top of major stars and transformations—Tian Xing adds rules and pressure, Tian Yao adds charm and social appeal.
cnDesc: 天刑和天姚是乙级杂曜，力量不如主星和四化，但在特定领域有明确的指向性。天刑主法律、规则、刑诉、手术、孤克；天姚主魅力、桃花、才艺、风情。它们不是独立判断吉凶的依据，而是在主星四化的基础上做「加减分」——天刑加重规则和压力，天姚增加魅力和人际缘。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数火星铃星：爆发力与暗火的能量管理与转化方法
enTitle: Huo Xing and Ling Xing in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Managing Explosive and Smoldering Energy
enDesc: Huo Xing and Ling Xing are the "fire" attribute malefics among the six baleful stars, governing impatience, explosion, and conflict. But they manifest differently: Huo Xing is "open fire"—comes fast, goes fast, erupts on the spot but holds no grudge; Ling Xing is "smoldering fire"—does not erupt on the surface but keeps it inside, easily accumulating into resentment. The key to managing them is not "never get angry" but "giving fire energy the right outlet."
cnDesc: 火星和铃星是六煞中的「火」属性星曜，主急躁、爆发、冲突。但两者的表现形式不同：火星是「明火烧」——来得快去得快，当场发作但不记仇；铃星是「暗火闷」——表面不发作但心里记着，容易积累成怨气。管理火铃的关键不是「不生气」，而是「让火气有正确的出口」。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看职场竞争：擎羊陀罗在官禄宫的明争暗斗与应对策略
enTitle: Workplace Competition Through Qing Yang and Tuo Lo in Zi Wei Dou Shu
enDesc: Workplace competition is a scenario everyone faces, but people with different charts compete very differently. Qing Yang governs "open blades"—direct, tough, face-to-face contest; Tuo Lo governs "entanglement"—circuitous, persistent, behind-the-scenes struggle. Understanding your own competitive style lets you leverage strengths and avoid weaknesses at work, rather than using the wrong approach and draining yourself.
cnDesc: 职场竞争是每个人都会遇到的场景，但不同命盘的人竞争方式完全不同。擎羊主「明刀明枪」——直接、强硬、当面较量；陀罗主「纠缠不清」——迂回、持久、暗中较劲。了解自己的竞争风格，才能在职场中扬长避短，而不是用错方式把自己消耗掉。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看职业倦怠：福德宫官禄宫的耗竭信号与恢复方法
enTitle: Occupational Burnout in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Fortune and Career Palace Depletion Signals
enDesc: Occupational burnout is not simply "tiredness," but a physical and mental state after long-term energy depletion. From the chart perspective, burnout is usually related to imbalance between the Fortune Palace (inner fulfillment) and Career Palace (work investment)—too much investment in Career, too little nourishment in Fortune, leading to depletion over time.
cnDesc: 职业倦怠不是简单的「累」，而是长期能量耗竭后的身心状态。从命盘看，职业倦怠通常和福德宫（内在满足感）与官禄宫（工作投入）之间的失衡有关——官禄宫投入太多，福德宫得不到滋养，时间长了就会耗竭。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看转行成本：大限官禄宫变动的时机选择与风险控制
enTitle: Career Switching Costs in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Timing and Risk Control
enDesc: Career switching is a choice many face, but costs vary by person. From the chart perspective, the timing and cost of switching are closely related to changes in the Decade Career Palace—some Decades naturally suit change, others suit stability. Choosing the wrong timing multiplies switching costs.
cnDesc: 转行是很多人在职业生涯中会面临的选择，但转行的成本因人而异。从命盘看，转行的时机和成本与大限官禄宫的变动密切相关——有些大限天然适合变动，有些大限则适合稳守。选错时机，转行成本会成倍增加。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看远程办公适配：命宫迁移宫组合与居家工作的自我管理
enTitle: Remote Work Compatibility in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Life and Migration Palace Combinations
enDesc: Remote work has become the norm for many, but not everyone suits it. From the chart perspective, remote work compatibility relates to the combination of Life Palace (self-management ability) and Migration Palace (outward/public energy)—some are more efficient at home, others can only get into gear in an office.
cnDesc: 远程办公已经成为很多人的工作常态，但不是所有人都适合。从命盘看，远程办公的适配度和命宫（自我管理能力）与迁移宫（外出/公域能量）的组合有关——有些人在家效率更高，有些人必须在办公室才能进入状态。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看职场贵人：天魁天钺落宫的贵人类型与经营方法
enTitle: Workplace Benefactors in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Tian Kui and Tian Yue Placements
enDesc: Tian Kui and Tian Yue are the "benefactor stars" in Zi Wei Dou Shu, governing help from benefactors and关键时刻 support. But benefactors do not fall from the sky; Tian Kui/Tian Yue only provide "opportunities and connections," and whether you can seize them depends on your Life and Career palaces. Knowing where benefactors lie tells you which direction to seek help.
cnDesc: 天魁天钺是紫微斗数中的「贵星」，主贵人相助、关键时刻有人提携。但贵人不是天上掉下来的，天魁天钺只提供「机会和人脉」，能不能抓住还要看自己的命宫和官禄宫。了解贵人落在哪里，就能知道应该往哪个方向寻找帮助。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看与上司关系：父母宫的权威映射与上下级相处之道
enTitle: Superior Relationships in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Parents Palace as Authority Mapping
enDesc: In Zi Wei Dou Shu, the Parents Palace represents not only parents but also "authority figures"—superiors, leaders, teachers, elders. Your relationship pattern with parents often replicates in relationships with superiors. Understanding the star combinations in the Parents Palace helps explain why you always clash with certain types of bosses and how to improve.
cnDesc: 在紫微斗数中，父母宫不仅代表父母，也代表「权威人物」——上级、领导、老师、长辈。你和父母的关系模式，往往会复制到和上司的关系中。了解父母宫的星曜组合，就能理解自己为什么总是和某些类型的上司合不来，以及如何改善。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看偏财运势：贪狼破军在财帛宫的机会型收入与风险控制
enTitle: Windfall Fortune in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Tan Lang and Po Jun in Wealth Palace
enDesc: Windfall income refers to non-salary income—investment, speculation, side business, bonuses, unexpected gains. In Zi Wei Dou Shu, windfall is closely related to change-type stars like Tan Lang and Po Jun. Tan Lang governs opportunity and desire, Po Jun governs change and breakthrough; people with these stars in Wealth Palace often have a talent for "non-traditional earning," but also easily lose from speculation.
cnDesc: 偏财指非固定工资的收入——投资、投机、副业、奖金、意外之财。在紫微斗数中，偏财和贪狼、破军等变动型星曜关系密切。贪狼主机会和欲望，破军主变动和突破，这两颗星在财帛宫的人，往往有「非传统赚钱」的天赋，但也容易因投机而亏损。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看债务管理：财帛宫化忌陀罗的纠缠与脱困方法
enTitle: Debt Management in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Jealousy and Tuo Lo Entanglement in Wealth Palace
enDesc: Debt is a financial困境 many face, but from the chart perspective, people prone to debt often have specific star structures—Wealth Palace Jealousy (lessons in the money domain), Tuo Lo (entanglement, delay, snowballing), Di Kong/Di Jie (impractical spending or investment). Understanding these signals helps adjust before debt becomes severe.
cnDesc: 债务问题是很多人面临的财务困境，但从命盘看，容易陷入债务的人往往有特定的星曜结构——财帛宫化忌（钱的领域有课题）、陀罗（纠缠、拖延、越滚越大）、地空地劫（不切实际的消费或投资）。了解这些信号，有助于在债务还不严重时及时调整。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看房产投资：田宅宫四化的不动产时机与买卖窗口
enTitle: Real Estate Investment in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Tian Zhai Palace Transformations and Timing
enDesc: The Tian Zhai (Property) Palace represents real estate, family, and living environment in Zi Wei Dou Shu. Its transformations and star combinations reflect a persons property luck—when to buy, when to sell, whether property appreciates or drains wealth. But real estate is a major decision; the chart is only reference, final decisions need actual financial conditions and market environment.
cnDesc: 田宅宫是紫微斗数中代表不动产、家庭、居住环境的宫位。田宅宫的四化和星曜组合，可以反映一个人的房产运——什么时候适合买房、什么时候适合卖房、房产是增值还是耗财。但房产是大额决策，命盘只能作为参考，最终决策需要结合实际经济状况和市场环境。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看合伙财运：兄弟宫财帛宫合参与合伙避坑指南
enTitle: Partnership Wealth in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Siblings and Wealth Palace Analysis
enDesc: Partnership entrepreneurship is a path many choose, but success rates are not high. From the chart perspective, whether you suit partnerships, who to partner with, and how to distribute power can be seen from the combination of Siblings Palace (peers/partners) and Wealth Palace (money distribution).
cnDesc: 合伙创业是很多人会选择的方式，但合伙的成功率并不高。从命盘看，是否适合合伙、和什么人合伙、合伙中如何分配权力，都可以从兄弟宫（平辈/合作伙伴）和财帛宫（钱财分配）的组合中看出端倪。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看财富传承：田宅宫父母宫的代际传递与规划方法
enTitle: Wealth Inheritance in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Tian Zhai and Parents Palace Intergenerational Transfer
enDesc: Wealth inheritance is an issue many middle-class and above families face. From the chart perspective, the combination of Tian Zhai Palace (real estate/family assets) and Parents Palace (elders/inheritance) reflects whether a person has inheritance luck and potential problems in the process. But wealth inheritance is complex legal and financial planning; the chart is only reference.
cnDesc: 财富传承是很多中产以上家庭会面临的问题。从命盘看，田宅宫（不动产/家庭资产）和父母宫（长辈/遗产）的组合，可以反映一个人是否有继承运、以及传承过程中可能遇到的问题。但财富传承是复杂的法律和财务规划，命盘只能作为参考。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看伴侣财运：夫妻宫财帛宫组合与家庭财务分工
enTitle: Partner Financial Fortune in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Spouse and Wealth Palace Combinations
enDesc: In marriage, money is one of the most common sources of conflict. From the chart perspective, the combination of Spouse Palace (partner traits) and Wealth Palace (your own fortune) reflects the financial pattern between you and your partner—complementary or conflicting, joint accumulation or separate management. Understanding this pattern helps build healthy financial division in marriage.
cnDesc: 婚姻中，钱是最容易引发矛盾的话题之一。从命盘看，夫妻宫（伴侣特质）和财帛宫（自己的财运）的组合，可以反映你和伴侣之间的财务模式——是互补还是冲突、是共同积累还是各自为政。了解这个模式，有助于在婚姻中建立健康的财务分工。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看感情控制欲：化权在夫妻宫的掌控模式与边界建立
enTitle: Control Desire in Relationships: Authority in Spouse Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu
enDesc: In intimate relationships, control desire is a common source of conflict. From the chart perspective, people with Authority in Spouse Palace tend to want to "control everything" in relationships—managing the partners social life, spending, schedule. But the essence of control desire is often not lack of love, but "fear of losing." Understanding the source helps build healthy boundaries in the relationship.
cnDesc: 亲密关系中，控制欲是常见的矛盾来源。从命盘看，化权在夫妻宫的人，在感情中容易有「想掌控一切」的倾向——管对方的社交、消费、时间安排。但控制欲的本质往往不是不爱，而是「害怕失去」。了解控制欲的来源，才能在关系中建立健康的边界。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看冷战模式：天同太阴在夫妻宫的回避型沟通与改善方法
enTitle: Cold War Patterns in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Tian Tong and Tai Yin Avoidant Communication
enDesc: Cold war is one of the most damaging communication styles in intimate relationships—no arguing, but also no talking, no responding, using silence to punish the partner. From the chart perspective, people with water-attribute stars like Tian Tong and Tai Yin in Spouse Palace easily use avoidance and cold war to handle conflict. Understanding this pattern breaks the "you dont say, I dont say" deadlock.
cnDesc: 冷战是亲密关系中最伤人的沟通方式之一——不吵不闹，但也不说话、不回应、用沉默来惩罚对方。从命盘看，天同、太阴等「水属性」星曜在夫妻宫的人，容易用回避和冷战来处理冲突。了解这种模式，才能打破「你不说我也不说」的僵局。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看复合可能性：大限夫妻宫重新引动的信号与判断
enTitle: Reconciliation Possibility in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Decade Spouse Palace Reactivation
enDesc: Whether to reconcile after a breakup is a question many struggle with. From the chart perspective, reconciliation often relates to reactivation of the Decade Spouse Palace—in a certain Decade or Annual period, the Spouse Palace is reactivated by transformations or stars, and an old flame may reappear. But reconciliation is not just "still love or not," more importantly "have the problems that caused the breakup been resolved?"
cnDesc: 分手后要不要复合，是很多人纠结的问题。从命盘看，复合往往和大限夫妻宫的重新引动有关——某个大限或流年，夫妻宫被四化或星曜重新激活，旧人可能重新出现。但复合不只是「还爱不爱」，更重要的是「导致分手的问题解决了没有」。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看婚姻财产：夫妻宫田宅宫的财产关系与权益保护
enTitle: Marital Property in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Spouse and Tian Zhai Palace Relations
enDesc: Marriage is not only an emotional union but also a financial union. From the chart perspective, the combination of Spouse Palace (partner relationship) and Tian Zhai Palace (family assets) reflects property patterns in marriage—joint or separate, whether property brings closeness or conflict. Understanding this helps protect both the relationship and rights in marriage.
cnDesc: 婚姻不仅是感情的结合，也是财产的结合。从命盘看，夫妻宫（伴侣关系）和田宅宫（家庭资产）的组合，可以反映婚姻中的财产模式——是共同财产还是各自独立、是因为财产更亲密还是因为财产生矛盾。了解这些，有助于在婚姻中既保护感情也保护权益。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看消化系统：疾厄宫天同巨门的体质倾向与调养方法
enTitle: Digestive Health in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Tian Tong and Ju Men in Health Palace
enDesc: In Zi Wei Dou Shu, the Health Palace reflects a persons constitutional tendencies and body systems prone to issues. Tian Tong governs spleen-stomach and dampness, Ju Men governs mouth, esophagus, and intestines; people with these stars in Health Palace often need to pay special attention to the digestive system. But the chart only indicates "tendency," it cannot replace medical diagnosis.
cnDesc: 在紫微斗数中，疾厄宫可以反映一个人的体质倾向和容易出问题的身体系统。天同主脾胃、水湿，巨门主口腔、食道、肠道，两颗星在疾厄宫的人，消化系统往往是需要特别关注的领域。但命盘只能提示「倾向」，不能替代医学诊断。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看心血管健康：疾厄宫太阳廉贞的体质倾向与预防方法
enTitle: Cardiovascular Health in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Tai Yang and Lian Zhen in Health Palace
enDesc: Tai Yang is fire element, governs heart, blood circulation, and eyes; Lian Zhen is fire element, governs blood, inflammation, and cardiovascular system. People with these two fire stars in Health Palace often have the cardiovascular system as a weak link in their constitution. Especially after middle age, need to pay special attention to blood pressure, blood lipids, and heart health. The chart indicates tendency; specifics follow medical examinations.
cnDesc: 太阳属火，主心脏、血液循环、眼睛；廉贞属火，主血液、炎症、心血管。两颗火属性星曜在疾厄宫的人，心血管系统往往是体质中的薄弱环节。尤其是中年以后，需要特别关注血压、血脂和心脏健康。命盘提示倾向，具体以医学检查为准。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看睡眠质量：福德宫煞曜的影响与改善方法
enTitle: Sleep Quality in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Fortune Palace Malefics and Improvement
enDesc: Sleep problems are a common modern complaint. From the chart perspective, the star combinations in the Fortune Palace (mental state, inner world) greatly affect sleep quality—people with heavy malefics in Fortune Palace easily overthink, feel tense, and have difficulty falling asleep. Understanding your sleep type helps find corresponding improvement methods.
cnDesc: 睡眠问题是现代人的常见困扰。从命盘看，福德宫（精神状态、内心世界）的星曜组合对睡眠质量影响很大——福德宫煞星重的人，容易思虑过多、精神紧张、入睡困难。了解自己的睡眠类型，才能找到对应的改善方法。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看兄弟姐妹关系：兄弟宫的互动模式与成年相处之道
enTitle: Sibling Relationships in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Siblings Palace Interaction Patterns
enDesc: The Siblings Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu represents not only siblings but also peers, colleagues, and partners. But the most direct mapping is sibling relationships—your interaction pattern with siblings, closeness, and whether there are利益 conflicts can be seen from the star combinations in the Siblings Palace.
cnDesc: 兄弟宫在紫微斗数中不仅代表兄弟姐妹，也代表平辈、同事、合作伙伴。但最直接的映射还是手足关系——你和兄弟姐妹的相处模式、亲疏远近、是否有利益冲突，都可以从兄弟宫的星曜组合中看出端倪。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看父母养老：父母宫田宅宫合参与养老规划
enTitle: Parental Elderly Care in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Parents and Tian Zhai Palace Analysis
enDesc: As parents age, elderly care becomes an issue many middle-aged people must face. From the chart perspective, the combination of Parents Palace (relations with parents) and Tian Zhai Palace (family/residence) reflects the role you play in parental care and potential problems. Understanding in advance helps with planning.
cnDesc: 随着父母年龄增长，养老成为很多中年人必须面对的课题。从命盘看，父母宫（与父母的关系）和田宅宫（家庭/居住）的组合，可以反映你在父母养老中扮演的角色、以及可能遇到的问题。提前了解，有助于做好规划。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看子女教育方向：子女宫的天赋识别与因材施教
enTitle: Child Education Direction in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Talent Identification from Children Palace
enDesc: Every child has own talents and personality; the best education is "teaching according to aptitude" rather than "carving by a mold." From the chart perspective, the star combinations in the Children Palace reflect a childs talent tendencies and personality traits—whether suited for academic, artistic, or athletic paths. Understanding this helps parents find the right education direction for the child.
cnDesc: 每个孩子都有自己的天赋和性格，最好的教育是「因材施教」而不是「按模子雕刻」。从命盘看，子女宫的星曜组合可以反映孩子的天赋倾向和性格特点——是适合走学术路线、艺术路线、还是运动路线。了解这些，有助于家长找到适合孩子的教育方向。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数大限走命宫：十年自我重塑期的特征与成长策略
enTitle: Decade Through Life Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Ten-Year Self-Reinvention
enDesc: The Decade is a ten-year fortune cycle in Zi Wei Dou Shu. When the Decade moves through the natal Life Palace, the theme of this decade is "self"—re-understanding yourself, reshaping life direction, changing from inside out. This is one of the most important transition periods in life; grasping it well can achieve leapfrog growth.
cnDesc: 大限是紫微斗数中十年为一个单位的运势周期。当大限走到本命命宫时，这个十年的主题是「自我」——重新认识自己、重塑人生方向、从内到外的改变。这是人生中最重要的转型期之一，把握好了可以实现跨越式成长。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数大限走财帛宫：十年财富重心期的机会与守成策略
enTitle: Decade Through Wealth Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Ten-Year Wealth Focus Period
enDesc: When the Decade moves through the natal Wealth Palace, the life focus of this decade naturally leans toward "money"—more earning opportunities, more financial decisions, stronger material desires. This is the golden period for accumulating wealth, but also the period most prone to money-related problems. Understanding the Decade Wealth Palace helps seize opportunities and preserve results this decade.
cnDesc: 当大限走到本命财帛宫时，这个十年的人生重心会自然偏向「钱财」——赚钱机会增多、财务决策变多、物质欲望增强。这是积累财富的黄金期，但也是最容易因为钱而出问题的时期。了解大限财帛宫的特征，有助于在这个十年既抓住机会又守住成果。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看流年桃花：红鸾天喜咸池的引动时间与正缘识别
enTitle: Annual Romance in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Hong Luan, Tian Xi, Xian Chi Activation
enDesc: Hong Luan, Tian Xi, and Xian Chi are the three main romance stars in Zi Wei Dou Shu. When the Annual period moves to the positions of these stars, romance luck is activated—may meet someone new, relationship has new progress, or old flame returns. But romance can be good or bad; understanding different romance stars helps meet the right person at the right time.
cnDesc: 红鸾、天喜、咸池是紫微斗数中最主要的三颗桃花星。当流年走到这些星曜的位置时，感情运会被引动——可能遇到新的人、感情有新进展、或者旧人回头。但桃花有正有烂，了解不同桃花星的含义，有助于在对的时间遇到对的人。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数可以看寿命吗：疾厄宫大限的健康参考边界与正确观念
enTitle: Can Zi Wei Dou Shu Predict Lifespan? Health Palace and Decade Boundaries
enDesc: Many people who consult fortune tellers, one of the most concerned questions is "how long can I live." But this question itself is problematic—Zi Wei Dou Shu can indicate constitutional tendencies and health risks, but cannot precisely predict lifespan. Using the chart as health reference is fine, treating it as a lifespan verdict is superstition.
cnDesc: 很多人找命理师看盘，最关心的问题之一就是「我能活多久」。但这个问题本身就有问题——紫微斗数可以提示体质倾向和健康风险，但不能精确预测寿命。把命盘当健康参考可以，把命盘当寿命判决书则是迷信。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数可以改运吗：命盘倾向与个人选择的真相
enTitle: Can Zi Wei Dou Shu Change Fortune? Chart Tendencies and Personal Choices
enDesc: "Changing fortune" is the hottest and most easily abused concept in the fortune-telling industry. Many people think spending money on rituals, buying lucky charms, or changing names can change destiny. But from the Zi Wei Dou Shu perspective, the chart reveals "tendencies and probabilities," not "predestined results." True fortune change does not rely on external forces, but on correct choices after understanding yourself.
cnDesc: 「改运」是命理行业最热门也最容易被滥用的概念。很多人以为花钱做法事、买吉祥物、改名字就能改变命运。但从紫微斗数的角度看，命盘揭示的是「倾向和概率」，不是「注定的结果」。真正的改运不是靠外力，而是靠了解自己后的正确选择。
